notes.title: Server closing of Lucky Night
notes.content:
To all the players of Lucky Night,

As we are planning to make big improvements to our product, we have decided to stop selling and close down Lucky Night on Steam since May 25, 2018.

We would like to thank you for all your supports and loyalty to Lucky Night in last few months. And welcome to follow our page for news about our coming games.

ATC Games



各位《lucky night》的玩家：

由于我们将对游戏进行全新升级，自2018年5月25日开始，《lucky night》将暂停在STEAM上的销售和游戏服务。

我们代表ATC Games团队，非常衷心的感谢各位玩家在过去的几个月里对《lucky night》的支持和热爱！欢迎在这段等待期间可以留意游戏的后续动态。


ATC Games团队

notes.title: Lucky Night UPDATE - 2 New Games Added
notes.content:
We add some new games in this UPDATE. Hope you like them.
[list]
[*]Add 2 New Games - Reversi and Bigger Game.
[*]Display the name above the head.
[*]You can select the Expression from the watch menu.
[*]Optimize the  features of foods.
[*]Fix a freezing problem when using watch menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Lucky Night UPDATE - AI takeover
notes.content:
In this update, you can join or leave the board game anytime. Don't worry losing the game. AI will take over it.
[list]
[*]You can take over AI when you join the game.
[*]AI takes over the game as soon as you leave.
[/list]
